title: AI in the EGI e-infrastructure -- Past experiences and future strategies
abstract: arXiv:2610.40494v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The EGI Federation has provided federated e-infrastructure services to European and global science for over 15 years. We review EGI's early experiences with AI in the interTwin and iMagine Horizon Europe projects, which built digital twins in physics and environmental sciences and an image-analysis platform for aquatic research. We then examine how the AI landscape has changed since 2023 and argue that the focus of AI in science has shifted from model training to adapting and applying AI to specific domains, projects and questions. Building on these lessons, we present the AI strategy emerging from the EGI Federation Strategy 2026-2030, organised around three enablers: (1) an AI-ready infrastructure connecting compute, data and application resources across the continuum; (2) human skills to know what is possible with AI and how to implement it; and (3) trust, to run AI with confidence even in high-risk environments. translated_title: EGI电子基础设施中的人工智能——过去的经验与未来的战略
translated_abstract: EGI联盟15年多来一直为欧洲乃至全球的科学研究提供联邦化的电子基础设施服务。我们回顾了EGI在“欧洲地平线”项目interTwin和iMagine中应用人工智能的早期经验，这两个项目分别在物理学和环境科学领域构建了数字孪生，并为水生科学研究搭建了图像分析平台。随后，我们分析了2023年以来人工智能领域格局的变化，并指出科学研究中人工智能的重点已从模型训练转向将人工智能适配并应用于特定的领域、项目和科学问题。基于这些经验教训，我们提出了源自《EGI联盟战略2026-2030》的人工智能战略，该战略围绕三大支撑要素展开：（1）连接计算、数据和应用资源、覆盖整个连续体的AI就绪型基础设施；（2）了解人工智能能做什么以及如何实施的人才技能；（3）信任，即即使在高风险环境中也能放心地运行人工智能。
tldr: 该论文总结了EGI在interTwin和iMagine项目中应用AI的早期经验，指出科学领域AI的重点已从模型训练转向面向特定领域的适配与应用，并据此提出EGI 2026-2030战略中以AI就绪型基础设施、人才技能和信任三大要素为核心的AI发展战略。
